about: P55 T2 sealed holdout: 80 sentences written by an independent agent without access to code, plans or sets. 60 target (8 per catch/whack/defense/slice, 7 per hop/crowd/merge/push) and 20 distractors (genre null). Opened once in T9.

sentences.text: Ripe apples drop off the old tree, slide your basket under them and skip the rotten ones
penguin waddles left and right scooping up falling fish, dont grab the snowballs
Stars are tumbling out of the night sky, help Luna collect them in her jar before they hit the ground. 3 lives
A chef stands under a leaky roof gathering raindrops in a pot while dodging drips of hot oil
Presents fall out of Santa's sleigh and the elf has to stuff them in his sack, lumps of coal cost a life
move a net along the beach to bag the shells the seagulls drop but let the crabs fall past
Bubble tea pearls raining down, run around with the cup and fill it up in 60 seconds
cupcakes plunging from a bakery window, hold out your tray to save them and ignore the burnt ones
Moles keep peeking out of the lawn, bonk them on the head before they duck back down
zombies poke out of their graves for like a second, tap them fast
Gophers pop out of burrows in the vegetable patch, smack them with a shovel, 45 seconds on the clock
Aliens peek through hatches in the spaceship floor and you zap each one before it hides again
Pirate heads show up from barrels on the deck, thump them but leave the parrot alone
Little goblins jump out of mushroom holes for a split second, squash as many as you can, 3 misses and you're out
hamsters keep sticking their heads up out of the sawdust tap tap tap
Robots rise from trapdoors in a factory for a heartbeat, knock them back down with a hammer before they vanish
Slimes crawl down three paths toward my castle, place archers so none of them reach the gate
Keep the bugs away from Grandpa's tomato garden, they come in waves along the rows
Orcs march down the lanes toward the village wall, don't let any break through. 5 lives
robot army rolling at our base in waves, guard it till wave 10
Zombies shuffle up the road to the farmhouse, hold them off with traps and turrets
Snowmen keep sliding down the lanes to put out our campfire, stop them before they get there
Ants are marching on the picnic blanket from every side, protect the cake until sunset
a kingdom under siege, wave after wave of knights charge the drawbridge and you have to keep them out

Samurai cat chops flying sushi rolls midair, don't touch the fireworks
veggies flung across the kitchen, slash them with your knife before they land
Ghosts drift across the haunted hall, swing your sword through them in midair but spare the candles

Coconuts launched out of a volcano and a ninja hacks them apart in the air, lava rocks hurt

Playing cards flick across a magician's table, cut every one before it drops, 60 seconds
A chicken has to get across a six lane highway without getting squished
frog crossing a river by jumping on logs and lily pads between the boats
Help Benny the bunny step over busy train tracks one row at a time
Cross a city street packed with taxis and buses, tap to move forward one lane at a time
a duckling has to make it over a busy bike path and a canal full of boats to reach its mom
Get the hedgehog to the far side of the farm while tractors roll across every row
Lava carts rush along the mine tracks and you inch forward lane by lane to the exit
Lead a tiny army through gates that multiply your soldiers, then slam into the enemy horde at the end
Run with a blob of stickmen, pick the plus doors not the minus ones, biggest group wins the battle
Grow a swarm of bees by flying through flower gates and then fight the wasp swarm
Pick up more and more penguins as you slide, take the x3 portal, final showdown against a walrus colony
Gather a band of pirates, steer through good and bad doorways, then storm the rival crew
my zombie horde gets bigger with every gate and at the end we crash into a mob of knights
Recruit kittens along the road by choosing the right gates, then your cat gang faces off with the dog pack
Drop fruits into a jar, two of the same squish into a bigger fruit, don't let it overflow
Toss planets into a box, matching ones fuse into the next planet up until you make the sun
dumplings fall into a steamer and identical ones combine into a giant bun
Two equal coins join into a bigger coin when they touch, keep dropping them into the piggy bank till it's full
puppies tumble into a basket and two matching ones become a bigger dog, aim for the golden retriever
Release gems into a glass tank, twin gems melt together into a rarer one, game over if they pile past the line
Plop baby slimes into a bucket, when two of the same color bump they turn into one bigger slime
Shove the other blobs off a floating platform but don't fall off yourself
bumper cars on an icy ring, knock the rivals out over the edge, last one standing wins
Hamster balls on a tiny island, ram the others into the water
Two chubby wrestlers in a circle, bump your opponent past the rope line before he does it to you
Penguins on a shrinking iceberg, nudge everyone into the sea and stay on yourself
Barge the robots off the edge of a spinning arena, best of three rounds
jelly bears jostling on top of a cake, be the last one left on the plate
Race a hot rod through the desert and catch up with the leader before the final lap
a fox hops between floating islands to climb all the way up to the clouds
Defend your title in a boxing match against the champ, three rounds
Surf the biggest wave in Hawaii and pull off tricks for points
Shooting gallery at the county fair, hit the ducks sliding past with a water pistol
endless runner on rooftops where you swipe to dodge chimneys and keep running
Manage a pizza shop and sell slices to a crowd of hungry customers before closing time
Fishing trip on a calm lake, cast your line and catch the biggest trout
rhythm game where you smash the drums in time with the beat
Golf on the moon, hit the ball into the crater in as few strokes as possible
Go on a quest to merge two halves of a torn magic map and find the treasure
Fly a paper plane through a canyon and push your luck by going faster
Build a city, drop roads and houses on the map and keep the citizens happy

Pilot a starfighter through an asteroid belt and take a whack at the boss mothership
skatepark session, hop over rails and grind ramps to rack up combo points
